tasks.short: Provide technical support to forestry research

steps.what: Clarify research questions and inspect forestry conditions with researchers
Provide practical technical support and resolve research implementation problems

tasks.design: Keep technical assessment and advice with the technician, using the current protocol in {DOCS}. Test existing document search before considering any separate preparation tool; this boundary contains no measured repetitive preparation to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research questions depend on site conditions and experimental intent.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access supports discussion, but does not supply local experimental judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising when practical adjustments undermine comparability or introduce confounding.
tasks.human_edge: The technician connects field observations, practical constraints and the researcher's intent.
tasks.altitude: Technical support and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review practical feasibility of a forest trial
reach.learn: Experimental controls and limits on extrapolation

evidence.claim: Site-specific research support remains an interpretive conversation; no labour reduction is established for this task.

assumptions: Boundary covers the technician's technical assistance; researchers' experimental design, approvals and separate sample collection retain their own time.
The researcher supplies the protocol and question before s1; the technician produces the assessment in s1. No machine consumes an assumed structured site assessment.
Check native document search first if a recurring retrieval problem is later observed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new application, model or data pipeline is introduced.
unknowns: Share of support involving recurring document retrieval
research_questions: Does observed support time contain a separate repetitive retrieval step large enough to justify a tool?

already_counted.description: Field interpretation and technical discussion remain fully counted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and focal incremental=0, net=0. Site-specific advice remains manual; no separate administrative baseline is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare plants, samples and equipment for laboratory or field experiments
Conduct experiments and observe biological responses and unexpected conditions

tasks.design: Retain physical preparation, experimental work and observation with the technician. Read the protocol in {DOCS}; separate analysis or report production requires its own observed baseline before proposing automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Biological materials and field conditions require physical handling and contextual observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital sample systems can track records, but do not remove this experimental work.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining treatment consistency while recognising contamination, specimen damage and unexpected responses.
tasks.human_edge: Skilled handling and awareness of departures from the protocol.
tasks.altitude: Experimental execution remains the technician's work.

reach.learn: Controls, replication and interpretation of deviations

evidence.claim: SampleManager LIMS tracks barcoded samples and test assignments; that capability does not demonstrate replacement of physical experimental execution.
Retaining the physical experiment and observation without a measured clerical subtask supports zero assumed labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers preparation and execution by the technician; research design, separate reporting and subsequent analysis are outside it.
Researcher supplies the protocol before s1; technician produces physical preparations in s1 and observations during s2. No machine is supplied free specimen identities or structured observations.
Check existing native sample recording before adding any future record tool; no recording savings are claimed here.
Zero incremental upkeep follows from introducing no new tool or structured capture obligation.
unknowns: Existing instrument automation and recording responsibilities
research_questions: What portion of observed experiment time is physical handling versus separately identifiable transcription?

already_counted.description: Physical preparation and experimental observation remain fully counted

incremental.description: No additional upkeep or transferred work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100; gross=0, incremental=0 and net=0. Physical experiments retain all time; potential downstream sample reporting is outside this baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Remains responsible for practical research support and experimental execution.
reach: Discuss experimental feasibility with foresters and conservation scientists
role.ambitious_version: A technician who strengthens the reliability of field trials through practical expertise.
